overview.title: Separate meaning from presentation
overview.explanation: The diagram focuses on one pairing; WarningReport also derives from Report and Plain also derives from Writer in the complete listing. Triangles mean inheritance. The Report-to-Writer dependency is the borrowing bridge, not ownership and not a call sequence.

focus.title: The shared report boundary
focus.what: A report borrows one formatting mechanism and protects the count rule.
focus.where: These protected members support both concrete report types.
focus.why: All formats receive validated report inputs without duplicating the validation.
focus.invariant: The writer stays alive and every report rejects negative counts.
focus.risk: A report that forgets validate can send invalid domain data onward.

focus.title: Choose meaning, then delegate
focus.what: CountReport decides the field name and asks the writer to display it.
focus.where: This is the high-level operation reached by a render call.
focus.why: The report should know count semantics without knowing punctuation.
focus.invariant: The original count reaches Writer unchanged after validation.
focus.risk: Calling a concrete formatter here would tie this report to one format.
